extraction_notes: LVR: manager's letter rounds to "an LVR of 47%" (page 2) while the key information summary states 46.52% - the more precise summary figure was taken. No actual interest cover ratio is disclosed; only the covenant threshold (net rentals no less than 2.0x interest expense, page 28; the post-balance-date ASB facility covenant is EBITDA no less than 2.0x interest, page 35). Distribution: 6.75% is the average distribution rate on original investment ($50,000 per unit); a distribution yield of 7.43% on closing equity is also presented. Adjusted operating profit recorded as the reported "Adjusted net profit" of $5,303,580; a separate "Cash surplus available" of $5,267,177 is also shown. No forecast figures are disclosed. Facility maturity 30/09/2026 (Westpac) was refinanced post balance date with ASB, effective 24 June 2026, expiring 23 June 2029; existing swaps were novated with unchanged terms. Page numbers given are 1-based PDF pages; the document's own printed page numbers are one lower. WALE: the Manager's letter says "3.4 years" (p.2) while the key information summary, Note 2 and the valuation summary all state 3.35 years - the more precise 3.35 is recorded. Occupancy is not stated as a percentage; Note 5 says the property "is fully leased at balance date" and the valuation summary gives a vacancy rate of 0.24% (2025: 0.26%). NBS: the 100% figure is a valuation assumption ("The valuation assumes the buildings meet 100% of New Building Standard (NBS)"), not an independently reported seismic rating. Capex: the fees table (p.10), the cash flow statement (p.17) and the non-GAAP reconciliation (p.8) all show capitalised investment property additions of $16,735, whereas Note 5 shows additions to the investment property column of $14,735 (total additions including lease incentives and leasing fees $34,403) - worth checking. Lease incentives: recorded as the $17,863 capitalisation figure in Note 3/Note 4; the non-GAAP reconciliation on p.8 shows the same amount as "Capitalised lease incentives paid (17,863)". Leasing fees to the Manager are shown as a dash (nil) in Note 13 for 2026 (2025: $10,340) and have been recorded as 0; the fees table separately shows $1,805 of capitalised leasing fees charged by other persons. Net lettable area is not disclosed anywhere in the report.
